messages:
andrew-ml: quick signal — the q6-int8 variant we pushed to canary is regressing on our 'scanbank' stress set vs fp16. overall rouge down ~6%, intent recall for 'multi-scan' down ~14%. attaching quick table:
```
model     bleu   recall_multi-scan   avg_latency
fp16      0.81   0.93                110ms
q6-int8   0.76   0.80                95ms
```
https://console.redwood/perf/canary/1768004321  

maya: ugh, that's bigger than i expected. where's the breakdown? per-language? :thinking:

andrew-ml: per-lang: en -3%, es -9%, ja -12%. failing patterns are long commands with nested lists + numeric tokens (e.g., "list 1. ..., 2. ..., between 2019-2021"). looks like tokenization noise + quantization shift on low-variance heads.

raj_labeler: we can create a focused labeling batch for nested-list + numeric intents. how many examples do you want and do we need pair-review/golden?

andrew-ml: target 2k HQA (high-quality) examples spread across en/es/ja. require 1:1 golden recheck for the first 500 so we can validate parity. priority: sequences with enumerations, dates, decimal tokens, and bracketed sublists.

maya: ops/people-ops question — can we book extra labeler capacity next week? cc @people-ops. also need a short rubric for the nested-list edgecases.

nate-m: tagging infra — enlarging canary for q6-int8 needs an automatic fallback. if recall drops >10% we should route traffic back to fp16. deploy-bot, can we instrument that?

deploy-bot: [deploy-note] q6-int8 rolled to 10% canary at 2026-03-18T09:10Z :white_check_mark:. Canary monitors: latency, 3 eval metrics, and custom recall alert.

eli: quick experiment idea — try per-channel scale quant calibration (topology-aware) on the failing attention heads before a full rollback. often recovers recall on numeric-heavy tokens with minimal latency impact.

andrew-ml: good call. i'll run a per-head calibration pass tonight and post diff artifacts (per-token confusion matrices). if that doesn't recover, we still want the label batch to expand stress coverage.

raj_labeler: starting a task template: "scanbank-nested-lists-v1" and a small seeding set. link: https://task.redwood/label/scanbank-nested (internal). Will include rubric + examples.

sophia: happy to QA the golden checks, prefer pair-review for the first 200 examples. can coordinate with raj.

raj_labeler: ETA: first 500 by EOD Fri, full 2k by next Wed. pair-review scheduled for Tue-Wed.

andrew-ml: perfect. i'll run quant-calib tonight and share initial patches + eval diffs here. thanks everyone :pray:

maya: noted — setting up a 15m sync Thu to go over results and decide whether to broaden canary or fallback. :calendar:
